proposed_facts.reason: The header declares the fields and three-entry aggregate; the source defines gTRKMsgBufs. Size annotations are correctly distinguished from compiled layout proof.
Initialization, allocation, release and reset match the described transitions. Canonical mutex implementations return success without locking.
Allocation resolves each candidate, writes both outputs only on success, initializes the pointer to NULL and leaves the index untouched on exhaustion.
The first free slot is reset with keepData=1 and claimed; assigning NUM_BUFFERS to the loop counter still permits the release call before exit.
The ui32 helper requests sizeof(*data), returns the raw reader status and reverses only after success. The raw reader truncates short transfers and advances by the available prefix.

The ui64 temporary uses sizeof(data), while the transfer uses sizeof(*data) and reversal indexes eight bytes. The conditional size warning is supported without asserting target execution or compiled stack layout.
Release clears the occupancy flag used by allocation; mutex API bracketing does not establish mutual exclusion.
The explicit -1 return and 0–2 guard are exact. Valid release changes only occupancy, with no metadata or payload reset.
The setter unconditionally assigns fInUse. Lifecycle callers bracket it with the verified no-op mutex APIs.
The canonical implementation supports the stated pool, cursor, transfer and serialization roles, but not synchronized allocation or release.
Lifecycle and short-read effects match source. Generic append assigns length from the resulting cursor, whereas inline byte append increments length independently.

contradictions.reason: The layout-certainty contradiction is resolved by proposal index 0. Header comments remain useful annotations, not proof of compiled offsets, aggregate size or section extent.

The synchronization contradictions are resolved by proposal indices 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10. Lifecycle API bracketing is real, but initialization, acquisition and release implementations merely return success.
The unconditional four-byte-consumption claim is corrected by proposal index 4: four bytes are requested, but shortage consumes only the available prefix.

The unconditional safe alternate-endian ui64 conversion claim is corrected by proposal index 5. Runtime manifestation remains explicitly deferred because the source-level size mismatch and endian initialization do not establish execution of the affected branch.

Accepted caller-level ownership deferral: packet intake ignores allocation failure, can inspect an uninitialized id, and ignores event-post failure. Event destruction releases an attached buffer, but this does not prove cleanup on every exceptional path.

Accepted caller-level error-propagation deferrals: FP and paired-single access overwrite earlier statuses, and dispatch uses command without checking the byte-reader status. Helper first-error behavior must not be generalized through these callers.
